g.text: Cohesive energy accumulated over (a)–(c) exceeds the strength of the glycosidic backbone.

text.style: font-size: 6.3px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #1a1a19

g.text: Cellulose therefore decomposes near 300 °C before any melting transition is reached, and

text.style: font-size: 6.3px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #1a1a19

g.text: dissolves only in solvents that can break the hydrogen-bond network.
